paragraphs.text: Critical security patches released for Citrix NetScaler, PTC Windchill and FlexPLM, alongside active exploitation of Check Point Security Gateways and ConnectWise ScreenConnect deployments, collectively weaken vulnerability management and third-party risk assurance across remote access and application delivery infrastructure. Vulnerability and asset owners should confirm patch deployment for affected NetScaler, Windchill, FlexPLM, and Check Point gateways, while supplier risk owners verify ScreenConnect remediation across MSP relationships.

A campaign compromising 4,837 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials and a social engineering operation targeting Microsoft access tokens at law firms weaken identity and access assurance through credential theft at scale. Identity and access owners should review GitHub token hygiene, monitor for suspicious repository activity, and confirm token protection measures and phishing awareness training.
